kuhn_poker.note: Scoped proof-of-concept only (PLAN.md's Verification section: 'Any CMA-ES results (stretch phases) are explicitly reported as scoped proof-of-concept') -- validates that sep-CMA-ES generalizes to kuhn_poker using the same mechanism Phase 7 already validated on kuhn_poker, not a kuhn_poker-strength claim. Deliberately a smaller CMA-ES budget than Phase 7's kuhn_poker-only pilot (this phase spreads its budget across 3 games to check generalization, not to re-prove convergence on any one). Opponent is gtbench's own RandomAgent (no LLM, always legal) -- a cheap fixed baseline to validate the training loop against, not a benchmark. Evolved parameters are the selection head's weight+bias ONLY, same scoping as Phase 7/8.

note: Multi-game extension of Phase 7's kuhn_poker-only sep-CMA-ES pilot (PLAN.md phase table: 'gtbench extension (connect_four/breakthrough + kuhn_poker)') -- each game's own entry under 'games' carries its own scoped-proof-of-concept disclaimer.
